rgb_note: Cropped to the well-scanned zone (within 5 m of the walking path). Photo exposure and white balance were equalized per image before blending; people were removed with photo masks and LiDAR free-space carving.

slam_map.note: Black = walls (occupied over ≥1.2 m of height), gray = furniture and low objects, white = floor seen by the scanner, blue-gray = never observed. Grid 5 cm.

model.method: Screened Poisson reconstruction (octree depth 12, ~6 mm) of the denoised, people-free 1 cm LiDAR cloud, trimmed to within 3 cm of real points and decimated to 1,800,000 triangles; vertex colors from exposure-equalized photos.

splat.note: 3D Gaussian Splatting (gsplat) trained on 1,487 undistorted fisheye photos at 1.5x resolution (1458x1944), with SLAM-refined poses. It was initialized from the 1 cm HQ LiDAR cloud near the path plus a 2 cm cloud farther out. People were masked out of the photos, and the splat depth was supervised by the people-free (carved) LiDAR cloud. Best viewed from inside the corridors near the walking path.
